notes: LOC is wc -l of UE 5.8.3 PostProcess/TemporalSuperResolution.cpp and Shaders/Private/TemporalSuperResolution files, split by measured line ranges. Resurrection, reprojection field, flickering and rejection anti-aliasing are on in the Epic scalability level (BaseScalability.ini:85-94) even where the cvar default is 0.

internals: CVars, tiers and defaults
History sample count 16, history size, update quality, rejection anti-aliasing, flicker and resurrection switches.
partial
Temporal AA is the default at high and medium (PRD-636 Phase 4). No temporal tier table exists. PRD-720 Phase 3.
Wave size, 16-bit math and async compute
Chooses wave size and half-precision math per vendor and overlaps passes on the async queue.
deferred
WebGPU has no async queue and no portable wave size control. Revisit when subgroup size control ships in WebGPU.
Shader parameter structs and permutations
Declares every pass's parameters and permutation domain.
rule
Plumbing for one shader compiler. TSL and the owned engine have their own.
Pass gating and measure passes
Decides which passes run and dispatches the flicker luma and thin geometry coverage measures.
shipped
RenderChain provisions velocity only when a temporal stage asks (PRD-455).
History setup: sizes, jitter, validity and reset
Sizes input, history and output, advances the jitter, and clears history on a cut.
partial
Lifecycle ships (PRD-455). History above output resolution is PRD-539 Phase 1 box 1.
Velocity, occluder and decimate dispatch
Dispatches the clear, dilate and decimate passes.
open
PRD-717 adds the occluder scatter and its test.
Rejection and spatial anti-aliasing dispatch
Dispatches thin geometry, weight relaxation, rejection and the spatial anti-aliaser.
partial
PRD-539 names the rejection levers. PRD-719 changes the rejection space.
Update and resolve dispatch
Dispatches the history update and the resolve to output.
partial
Resolve ships at screen size. PRD-720 adds the kernel.
Output, history extraction and visualize dispatch
Extracts the history and runs the 16 visualization views.
deferred
PRD-676 defers TSR visualize because PRD-539's script reports the rejected-history ratio. Revisit when an agent cannot read a ghosting cause from that ratio.
Update: setup, quality levels and kernel tables
Macros for the sample pattern per quality and the predictor machinery.
open
PRD-720 Phase 2 and 3.
Update: reprojection fetch, field and lens distortion
Fetches velocity, applies the reprojection field and lens distortion to the history coordinate.
partial
Plain velocity reprojection ships. The field is PRD-539 lever 5 (named, no box). Lens distortion is not a ThreeNative post effect.
Update: history reprojection with Catmull-Rom fetch
Fetches and corrects the previous history with a bicubic filter.
shipped
PRD-455 compared the Catmull-Rom history resample.
Update: input filter at predictor frequency
Filters the current input with a kernel sized by the rejection and the sample count.
open
TRAANode reads one input texel. PRD-720.
Update: validity clamp, quantize and history write
Clamps validity under motion, quantizes it, protects against NaN and writes history and mip 1.
partial
The velocity weight clamp is PRD-539 lever 2 (named, no box). Propose a box.
Reprojection field encoding
Packs the field offset, boundary and 2 by 2 Jacobian.
partial
PRD-539 lever 5 says try after levers 1 to 4. The scalability file turns it on from High. Propose a box.
Resolve history to output
Filters the history down to the output resolution.
partial
Needed by the 200 percent history of PRD-539 Phase 1 box 1.
Decimate history for rejection
Reprojects the history to the input grid for the rejection, tests parallax disocclusion and reprojects the resurrected frame.
open
PRD-717 (parallax test) and PRD-718 (resurrection).
Clear previous-frame scratch textures
Clears the atomic scratch textures each frame.
rule
A buffer clear. PRD-717 owns the buffer.
Rejection pass: moire, measure, guide update, resurrection choice
Compares input and history in a display space, decides how much history to keep and updates the guide.
partial
Variance clipping ships. PRD-539 lever 4 (moire error) is named without a box. PRD-719 changes the space. PRD-718 uses the resurrection choice.
Shading analysis library
Moments and error measures with a display noise floor.
open
Color spaces and back-buffer quantization error
Guide and rejection color spaces, luminance weights and the display step.
open
Flickering luma measure
Stores the luma before translucency for the flicker analysis.
partial
PRD-539 lever 4 (flicker-aware rejection) is named in Context and Decisions with no box. Propose a box.
Weight relaxation
Relaxes the history weight for thin geometry using the network.
deferred
Rides with thin geometry detection and the network. Revisit with them.
Velocity dilation
Takes the velocity of the closest depth in the neighbourhood and anti-aliases it by depth.
partial
TRAANode takes the closest depth of 3 by 3 (PRD-269 supplies the velocity). The anti-aliased dilation belongs to the reprojection field.
Closest-occluder scatter and parallax disocclusion test
Scatters each pixel's closest depth and velocity into the previous frame with an atomic max, then tests and hole-fills.
open
Depth and velocity analysis (depth error, bilaterals, Jacobian, edge)
Computes depth error from the format, bilateral weights, the reprojection Jacobian and the reprojection edge.
partial
Depth error serves PRD-717. The Jacobian and edge serve the reprojection field (PRD-539 lever 5).
Network weights and layer code
A small learned network of convolutions run in tiles of 32 by 32.
deferred
The weights are Epic's trained data, so a clean-room port needs its own training. Revisit if PRD-539 gate arms 1 to 4 and PRD-719 fail.
Tiled network pass
Runs the network without a round trip to memory, with an overscan.
deferred
Same as the network.
Common types, packing and wave helpers
Shared types, bit packing and wave helpers.
rule
Plumbing.
Reconstruction kernels and neighbourhood offsets
Kernel weights and neighbourhood pixel offsets for the filters.
open
